scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:elm && vite build
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:js: prettier --check --log-level warn "{src,public,scripts,tests,engine/tests}/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs}" "*.config.js" && eslint src public scripts tests engine/tests "*.config.js"
scripts.test: python3 scripts/train-rhythm-model.py --check && npm run build:wasm && cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml && node --test tests/*.test.mjs engine/tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.predev: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:elm
scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:elm
